text:
maya: Heads-up: ACME demo tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC APAC. Need 3x H100s in ap-northeast1. Can we lock these?
sam: We have a soft-hold from cloud-supplier but no confirmed reservation yet. Did you want us to request a short-term reserve?
maya: Yes please Noticed some other tenants poke that window. @ops-bot any existing reservation for acme-prod?
ops-bot: lookup: tenant=acme-prod window=2025-11-20T02:00Z/2025-11-20T04:00Z -> soft-hold by partner 'cloud-supplier' exp 2025-11-19T22:00Z. No confirmed reservation.
leo: Finance needs cost center before procurement can confirm. @billing-bot rough cost for 3 H100s x2h ap-northeast1?
billing-bot: Est: 3 H100 * 2h = ~$1,800 on-demand. +10% buffer => ~$1,980. Add cost_center tag to auto-bill.
jia: I can draft the infra PR: "demo-reserve-acme-prod - ap-northeast1 - 3 H100 - 2h". Should include fallback to A100. Anyone object?
maya: No objections. Fallback allowed. Sam, make sure runtime routing prefers h100 then a100.
sam: Will do. Suggested config: `fallback_policy: ["h100","a100"]` and canaries at start +30m.
jia: Opening PR now and tagging @tara for approval.
ops-bot: reservation draft rdw-88123 attached to PR. Status: pending procurement.
tara: Reviewing. Quick ask: add `notify: [\"eng-oncall\",\"product\"]` so oncall sees it.
jia: Added.
ops-bot: rdw-88123 approved by procurement. Allocation: 3 H100s ap-northeast1 02:00-04:00 UTC.
sam: I'll schedule canaries and merge the fallback. Thanks team.
maya: PR merged and runbook updated. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
